name: Szentgyörgyvár (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Szentgyörgyvár: a red and blue shield with a bunch of grapes, a castle, a mushroom and Saint George on horseback, above a red scroll inscribed SZENTGYÖRGYVÁR.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
